extensionDescription.message: Give Audio Source Mixer independent control of the current tab after you click the extension.

actionTitle.message: Enable or stop independent audio control for the current tab

welcomePageTitle.message: Get started with Audio Source Mixer Tab Enhancement

welcomeLead.message: The extension enhances the current tab only after you click its toolbar icon. It does not capture tabs automatically or connect to the desktop app while the browser is idle.

welcomeReturn.message: If this page opened after your first click, finish reading, return to the original tab, and click the extension icon again.

welcomeStep1Body.message: Keep Audio Source Mixer running or in the notification area.

welcomeStep2Body.message: Open the site you want to control and begin playback.

welcomeStep3Body.message: The browser asks to share the current tab's audio. Click again to stop.

welcomeStep4Body.message: You can then control volume, balance, output device, and equalizer.

welcomeOutputTitle.message: Output devices require explicit confirmation once

welcomeOutputBody.message: When you choose a non-default output for a tab, the browser opens the device authorization page. Choose the same physical device, play the test tone, then confirm. The extension does not record audio.

welcomeDetail1Body.message: You may close the main window and leave the app in the notification area.

welcomeDetail2Body.message: Return to the tab that is playing audio and click the toolbar extension icon.

welcomeDetail3Title.message: Find the source in the mixer

welcomeDetail3Body.message: Cards labeled Browser enhanced support 0–200% volume, balance, ten-band EQ, and output selection.

welcomeDetail4Body.message: Follow the authorization page and listen before confirming. A name mismatch requires a second confirmation.

welcomeDetail5Body.message: Click the icon again to stop. If no source appears, make sure the desktop app is running and click again.

welcomeSaved.message: Saved. You can close this page and click the extension icon.

authorizeLead.message: Confirm that the Windows device and the browser's system selection refer to the same physical device. This page does not record audio or save the test sound.
